title: Template rules policy
description: A dynamic policy map keyed by rule directory paths under rules/.

defaultSeverity.description: Severity for source findings without a rule override.

fixtureSeverity.description: Display severity for expected fixture findings. Fixture regressions remain errors.

overrides.description: Severity overrides keyed by full rule directory path.

ruleSettings.description: Open settings objects keyed by the corresponding rule folder path. Each rule owns its fields.

^rules/(?:[^/]+/)*[^/]+$.description: Settings owned by this rule. Rule-specific fields remain open for the owning rule.
